item.title: I wanted to give you an update on my record . When I made , it i...
item.description:
I wanted to give you an update on my record . When I made , it i believed this was my last record so I made the record I always wanted to make . I was in the hospital mostly but when I wasn’t all I did was write & record it .I want to tour more than anything. & I want to sing . That’s what keeps my soul & body happy .This album has so many incredible people who helped me , who gave me their best , were patient with the trauma . @butchwalker , @michaelstipe , Will Sargent , @xmadmx , Billie Joe Armstrong , Eg White , @moodyslowchords , @suzyshinn , @jdloveless & more .I’m not going to tell people red is blue anymore .Thank you for giving me the grace I need to prepare how to enter the world again .Courtney ️
